Photography

This photograph was taken during my September 2026 trip to Budapest, Hungary. I wanted to capture the monument from a perspective that emphasized its movement, scale, and relationship with the open sky.

Gellért Hill · Budapest, Hungary · September 2026

Monument on Gellért Hill

A striking September moment on Gellért Hill in Budapest, capturing the Monument to Saint Gellért against a dramatic blue sky. The low-angle perspective emphasizes the statue’s powerful movement and sculptural form, while the sunlight and clouds create a sense of freedom, strength, and timelessness.
